card.title: Listen or read
card.body: Tap a card to hear the story from the start, or scroll down and read it. The first story is free.

play.title: Start listening
play.body: Tap the gold button. You can pause and resume from the lock screen too.

karaoke.title: Word-by-word follow
karaoke.body: As you listen, the word being read turns gold so your eyes can follow along.

seek.title: Jump anywhere
seek.body: Drag the waveform, or use the 15-second back and forward buttons.

speed.title: Set the speed
speed.body: Switches between 1×, 1.5× and 2× so long stories finish sooner.
